KITCHEN

About Us

Food that's fresh,
Brands you trust.

Rishabh's Kitchen is a food venture dedicated to serving delicious, affordable, and high-quality vegetarian food across Vadodara. We believe every meal should be an experience — crafted with fresh ingredients, prepared hygienically, and served with genuine care.

Our Mission
Serve fresh, hygienic, and delicious vegetarian food while building brands that customers love and trust.
Our Vision
Become one of India's most loved multi-brand food ventures through quality, innovation & customer delight.
3 Unique Food Brands
100% Vegetarian Menu

WHY

Why Choose Us?

Six reasons thousands of customers in Vadodara keep coming back.

  • 01
    100% Vegetarian MenuOur entire selection is crafted without meat or eggs — pure veg, every single dish.
  • 02
    Fresh Ingredients DailyWe source and prep everything fresh each morning. Zero compromise on quality.
  • 03
    Hygienic PreparationStrict hygiene standards across our kitchen, packaging, and delivery processes.
  • 04
    Affordable PricingGreat food at honest prices. We believe everyone deserves a delicious meal.
  • 05
    Three Brands Under One RoofThalis to falafels to fast food — unprecedented variety from one kitchen.
  • 06
    Catering & Bulk OrdersFeeding a crowd? We handle parties, events, and corporate gatherings seamlessly.
